backlog.spec: In infer()/tta, change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.15. This reduces the prediction time spent on 6-view flipped TTA at a small accuracy cost. Check the cost trade-off.
backlog.title: Skip TTA second-stage fraction 0.25 -> 0.15

backlog.spec: In _get_tta_logits, use only images_batch and its flip (2 views) instead of the 6 views with shifted crops. This cuts TTA compute by 3x. Keep the 25% uncertain quantile.
backlog.title: Drop to 2-view TTA (flip only)

backlog.spec: Set UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE=0.5 and use only 2 views (orig + flip) in _get_tta_logits. This tests whether broader but cheaper TTA gives better accuracy per second.
backlog.title: Larger TTA quantile with fewer views

backlog.spec: In train(), the whitening init uses 960 images. Try 500 images; the covariance estimate is only 12x12, so this should be nearly free. It is a tiny time saving.
backlog.title: Reduce whitening init sample

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=2048 and scale MUON_LR by about 1.1 and HEAD_LR and BIAS_LR by about 1.15. Fewer steps may give better GPU utilisation and less optimizer overhead. Keep EPOCHS the same.
backlog.title: Batch size 2048 with LR scaled

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE=1024 with the other hyperparameters unchanged. Check whether more steps give better accuracy at the same epochs, to see if the gain outweighs the extra time.
backlog.title: Batch size 1024

backlog.spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5, remove the third unrolled iteration and keep two. This saves optimizer time. Possibly retune target_magnitude.
backlog.title: Muon 2 Newton-Schulz iterations

backlog.spec: Use 3 NS iterations early but 2 when progress_ratio > 0.5. Because current_step is a Python int, it would recompile, so pass a bool flag instead. This tests a cheaper late-training optimizer.
backlog.title: Muon NS iterations in last epochs only reduced

backlog.spec: The Muon step periodically rescales filters to norm sqrt(D) via _foreach_norm. Replace the schedule with a fixed lower frequency (e.g. every 8 steps) to save kernel launches. Check accuracy.
backlog.title: Remove norm_freq rescaling of weights

backlog.spec: Increase LABEL_SMOOTHING from 0.09 to 0.12. This may improve TTA calibration slightly.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: Change the linear decay lr_factor2 to max(0.02, 1 - step*base) or conversely use a nonlinear (cosine-ish) tail. This tests schedule shape for the Muon and SGD groups.
backlog.title: Lower final LR floor: decay to 0 vs 0.02

backlog.spec: Add a short linear warmup over the first 10 steps for all LRs (multiply lr factors by min(1,(step+1)/10)). Stability early may allow higher peak LR.
backlog.title: Warmup of Muon LR

backlog.spec: Disable color_jitter in the train aug config (enabled False). This saves a kernel pass and tests whether it matters at 7.65 epochs.
backlog.title: Remove color jitter

backlog.spec: Set TRANSLATE=1. Less augmentation may speed convergence in a short schedule and make the pad and crop cheaper.
backlog.title: Translate 1 instead of 2

backlog.spec: Compute batch_color_jitter on the cropped images fused in one compiled function with batch_crop, to avoid an extra full-memory pass. Behaviour is unchanged.
backlog.title: Fuse jitter into crop

backlog.spec: Change widths block2 from 256 to 192 for speed, while keeping block3 at 256. This lowers FLOPs. Check whether the time saving beats the accuracy loss.
backlog.title: Block 2 width 192

backlog.spec: Reduce widths block1 from 64 to 48 (a multiple of 8 for tensor cores). This is cheap at the highest resolution. Keep the rest.
backlog.title: Block 1 width 48

backlog.spec: Set block3 width to 320 and cut EPOCHS to 7.0. A wider final block may be more sample-efficient.
backlog.title: Widen block 3 to 320 and reduce epochs

backlog.spec: Use nn.GELU in ConvGroup instead of SiLU, to see whether the activation is faster or more accurate when compiled.
backlog.title: Replace SiLU with GELU

backlog.spec: Change the output scaling in forward from division by x.size(-1) to a multiplication by 1/x.size(-1) times a factor 1.5 (a logit scale). Retune with HEAD_LR unchanged. It tests logit temperature with label smoothing.
backlog.title: Head scale tweak

backlog.spec: Increase WEIGHT_DECAY from 1.04e-6 to 3e-6, so wd = WEIGHT_DECAY*batch. A tiny regularisation change that may help generalisation.
backlog.title: Weight decay increase

backlog.spec: Raise MUON_MOMENTUM from 0.655 to 0.75 and reduce MUON_LR to 0.19. This tests the momentum-LR tradeoff.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.75

backlog.spec: Reduce WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS from 0.2 to 0.1 so that the whitening bias gradient is not computed for as long, saving a bit of backward compute. Check accuracy.
backlog.title: Whiten bias epochs 0.1

backlog.spec: Set WHITEN_BIAS_EPOCHS to 0 (or a tiny value) and pass whiten_bias_grad False always, so only one graph is compiled. This removes backward through the first conv input.
backlog.title: Freeze whiten bias entirely

backlog.spec: Change torch.compile(mode='max-autotune') in forward_step to mode None (or max-autotune-no-cudagraphs). Compile time is untimed, but the runtime kernels may differ. It tests whether CUDA graphs help.
backlog.title: Replace max-autotune in forward_step with default

backlog.spec: For the first ~40% of steps, train on 24x24 downsampled (interpolated) inputs, then switch to 32x32. The conv net is size-agnostic apart from the final MaxPool(3). This reduces time. It needs compiled graphs for both shapes (use dynamic=False and mark them separately).
backlog.title: Progressive resolution

backlog.spec: Set EPOCHS to 7.0 and increase MUON_LR by 5%. This tests the claim that the time-accuracy curve is flat with a slightly different operating point, and whether the LR retune shifts the curve.
backlog.title: Ramp epochs: slightly fewer epochs 7.0

backlog.spec: Remove the epoch-0 random flip batch_flip_lr pre-pass and simply flip all images on odd epochs. This saves one pass. It could slightly change the diversity.
backlog.title: Skip flip pre-pass in loader

backlog.spec: Increase the inference batch sizes B and tta_batch_size from 2000 to 5000, so there are fewer launches. This is a minor speed gain at identical outputs.
backlog.title: Half-precision TTA batch 5000

backlog.spec: In train(), change the progressive-resolution phase so inputs are interpolated to size (20, 20) instead of (24, 24) while step < 0.4 * total_train_steps. Everything else unchanged. The adaptive max pool at the end handles the shape; the cost is a possible recompile for the new shape, which happens in the untimed warmup.
backlog.title: Lower low-res phase to 20x20

backlog.spec: Replace the single low-res switch in train() with a ramp: for step < 0.25*total_train_steps interpolate inputs to (16,16), for step < 0.55*total_train_steps interpolate to (24,24), otherwise use full 32x32. Use bilinear, align_corners=False. Keep EPOCHS the same.
backlog.title: Three-stage resolution ramp 16/24/32

backlog.spec: Change the low-res threshold from 0.4 to 0.6 of total_train_steps (24x24 inputs), and raise EPOCHS from 7.65 to 8.0 to compensate slightly for lost accuracy. Net effect should be faster steps for more of training.
backlog.title: Longer low-res fraction 0.6 at 24px

backlog.spec: In _zeropower_via_newtonschulz5, delete the third unrolled iteration block (A = X @ X.T; B = ...; X = a*X + B@X) so only two iterations run. This cuts the optimizer matmul cost. Keep all other settings unchanged.
backlog.title: Muon with 2 Newton-Schulz iterations

backlog.spec: In ConvGroup.forward, keep conv1 then pool then norm, but replace the second block's full 256-channel conv in block3 with a depthwise-free cheaper option: reduce block2 width from 256 to 192 by setting widths block2=192 and block3=256. Fewer FLOPs in the highest-cost layers; leave EPOCHS at 7.65.
backlog.title: Drop the first conv's pooling order: pool after norm+activation off

backlog.spec: Change widths to dict(block1=48, block2=224, block3=256). Note block1 conv1 has 24 input channels from the whitening layer. This trims compute throughout; keep other hyperparameters the same.
backlog.title: Use channels-reduced block1 at 48 and block2 at 224

backlog.spec: Add a small regularizer after batch_crop: for each batch, zero (post-normalization value 0) a random 8x8 square per image at a random location using a compiled mask built from arange comparisons, applied only for step >= 0.4*total_train_steps. Enables fewer epochs: set EPOCHS to 7.0. Judge by whether accuracy holds despite fewer epochs.
backlog.title: Cutout-free random erasing on the batch

backlog.spec: Skip; instead replace with: Muon LR cosine-free warmup. Specifically, ramp the Muon and SGD learning rates linearly from 0.2x to 1x over the first 10 steps (lr_factor2 multiplied by min(1, 0.2 + 0.8*step/10)), then continue the existing linear decay. This may allow a higher peak MUON_LR of 0.23.
backlog.title: Ensemble-free EMA of weights for prediction

backlog.spec: In tta(), change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.15. This shortens inference time, which is timed. Accuracy may drop slightly; the aim is a net cost gain since predict is a measurable share of the 7.6 s.
backlog.title: Reduce TTA uncertain fraction to 0.15 and use 6 views only for them

backlog.spec: In train(), change the low-res phase interpolation size from (24, 24) to (20, 20), keeping the 0.4*total_train_steps threshold. Nothing else changes. This tests whether even cheaper early steps pay off (the 16x16 three-stage ramp was worse, so 20 is the middle ground).
backlog.title: Low-res phase at 20x20 for first 40%

backlog.spec: In train(), change the condition `step < 0.4 * total_train_steps` to `step < 0.6 * total_train_steps`, keeping the 24x24 bilinear downsample. Keep everything else the same.
backlog.title: Longer 24px phase to 60% of steps

backlog.spec: In train(), change the low-res phase to use size (28, 28) and threshold 0.5 * total_train_steps. This tests a milder resolution drop held for longer.
backlog.title: 28px low-res phase for 50% of steps

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE = 1024 (more steps per epoch, same EPOCHS). Scale nothing else except that wd uses BATCH_SIZE already. Tests whether more optimizer steps improve accuracy enough to offset the extra time.
backlog.title: Batch size 1024 with scaled epochs unchanged

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE = 2048, and multiply MUON_LR by 1.2, BIAS_LR by 1.2 and HEAD_LR by 1.2. Larger batches cut per-step overhead (Muon, launches); this checks if the time saving beats the accuracy loss.
backlog.title: Batch size 2048 with higher LRs

backlog.spec: Set LABEL_SMOOTHING = 0.12. Slightly more regularization, which may help with the short schedule and the low-res phase.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: In CifarNet.__init__, change widths to dict(block1=64, block2=192, block3=256). Block 2 convolutions are a major compute cost, so this cuts time at modest accuracy cost. Possibly pair with nothing else.
backlog.title: Block 2 width 192

backlog.spec: In tta(), set UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE = 0.15 instead of 0.25 to cut the extra 6-view inference time during predict, which is inside the timed region.
backlog.title: Reduce TTA uncertain fraction to 0.15

backlog.spec: In CifarLoader.__iter__, remove the batch_flip_lr pre-pass at epoch 0 (the proc_images['flip'] step) and make the pad step use the normalized images directly. Keep the every-other-epoch full flip. This removes one pass over the dataset, but the first-epoch flip randomness is lost, so check accuracy.
backlog.title: Skip loader flip pre-pass, random flip only via epoch parity

backlog.spec: Set BATCH_SIZE to 2048 (fewer, larger steps, better GPU utilisation). Scale BIAS_LR, HEAD_LR and MUON_LR by about 1.15x and keep EPOCHS 7.65. Weight decay is already multiplied by batch size, so leave it as is.
backlog.title: Batch size 2048 with scaled LRs

backlog.spec: Change the F.interpolate size in the training loop from (24, 24) to (20, 20) for the first 40% of steps. Everything else stays the same. This tests cheaper early training. Note that the compile for the new shape is untimed.
backlog.title: Low-res phase at 20x20 for first 40%

backlog.spec: Set LABEL_SMOOTHING from 0.09 to 0.12 to test slightly stronger smoothing in the short training schedule.
backlog.title: Label smoothing 0.12

backlog.spec: In the tta function, change UNCERTAIN_QUANTILE from 0.25 to 0.15. This reduces the 6-view inference work, a timed cost, at a small accuracy cost.
backlog.title: Reduce TTA uncertain fraction to 0.15

backlog.spec: In ConvGroup.__init__, change self.activ = nn.SiLU() to nn.GELU(). The stem already uses GELU. This tests whether the activation is faster or better under compile.
backlog.title: Replace SiLU with GELU in ConvGroup

backlog.spec: Change the widths dict so block2 is 192 instead of 256 (block3 stays 256). This reduces the cost of the middle convolutions. Muon's padding logic handles the new shapes automatically.
backlog.title: Block2 width 192

backlog.spec: In CifarLoader.__iter__ at epoch 0, remove the batch_flip_lr pre-flip of images, so proc_images['flip'] is not used. Keep the alternating epoch-parity flip, so each epoch is flipped deterministically as a whole. Make sure the translate path still pads the normalized images.
backlog.title: Skip loader flip pre-pass

backlog.spec: Set MUON_MOMENTUM from 0.655 to 0.75 for smoother orthogonalised updates. Leave the other settings unchanged.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.75

incumbent.description: Train the first 40% of steps on 24x24 bilinearly downsampled inputs (adaptive final max-pool, separate static compiled graphs), then switch to 32x32.

memo:
Helped: only slot 2, training the first 40% of steps on 24x24 downsampled inputs (official -0.1451 and -0.1278; incumbent mean -0.1364 over 2 runs). It carries a tripwire flag, so audit or replicate it before building on it. A fixed Muon rescaling interval (-0.1429, -0.0064 vs incumbent) is within noise, though it may simplify the code.

Did not help: the 16x16 three-stage ramp (+0.0250), the milder 28x28 phase held for 50% of steps (-0.0053 official), narrower block1 (+0.0921 vs incumbent), wider block3 (+0.0737 vs incumbent), LR warmup (+0.0515), weight decay 3e-06 (+0.0526), default compile mode (+0.0427), TRANSLATE 1 (+0.0360), logit scale 1.5 (+0.0366), no whitening bias training, and TTA with only two views. Small tweaks mostly failed.

Next: audit slot 2 first. Then tune the low-res fraction (30% or 50%) and the resolution (20) around 24. Avoid very low resolution and further tiny tweaks.
